exposure: Metroplasty at the stage of abdominal delivery
Resection of the scar area on the uterus
outcome: Dynamics of changes in scar thickness
Formation of a functionally sound scar on the uterus
cohort: 150 pregnant women who had undergone one or two previous cesarean section operations.
finding: Metroplasty performed during repeated cesarean sections improved the residual thickness of the myometrium 6 months post-operation, indicating the formation of a functionally sound scar.
mod_finding: The study evaluated the effectiveness of metroplasty performed during abdominal delivery (cesarean section) in women with previous cesarean sections.
